connector.name: Voila Groceries MCP
connector.registryDescription: Safe personal Voila grocery automation for search, slots, cart updates, and order history
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package voila-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the dearlordylord account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: VOILA_GUEST

env.name: VOILA_AUTH_SESSION_PATH
env.description: Absolute path to a session JSON file captured with the Voila CLI for authenticated account workflows.

env.name: VOILA_SESSION_WRITE_PATH
env.description: Optional path for updated session snapshots. Defaults to VOILA_AUTH_SESSION_PATH.
